stories.title: Woman says Al Fayed's brother drugged and sexually abused her at Highland estate
stories.summary: The woman says she was flown to the Fayed family's Balnagown estate, where she was repeatedly assaulted.

stories.title: Two arrested after police officers hurt in brawl outside bare-knuckle fighting event
stories.summary: Police Scotland said three officers were hurt as they responded to reports of a large disturbance in streets close to the Ovo Hydro venue in Glasgow.

stories.title: Driver killed in two-car crash on A94 in Angus named
stories.summary: The 34-year-old man was driving an Audi A1 when it was involved in a crash with a Ford Focus near Glamis on Thursday night.

stories.title: Scotland marks Remembrance Sunday silence for those who died in wars
stories.summary: Political leaders join communities across the nation in remembering those who died in world wars and other conflicts.

stories.title: The designers finding beauty in nature's darker side
stories.summary: The Glasgow-based designers behind Timorous Beasties have been telling stories in their subversive designs for decades.

stories.title: We face paying £9,000 tax even though our second home is in a war zone
stories.summary: A Ukrainian woman who fled to Scotland is told she and her partner could face a £9,000 property tax charge because she still owns a flat in Kyiv.

stories.title: Hutchinson beats Buatsi to win WBC light-heavyweight title
stories.summary: Willy Hutchinson is crowned WBC light-heavyweight champion as he produces the performance of his career against Joshua Buatsi in Manchester.

stories.title: Scotland's familiar frailties brutally exposed in All Blacks schooling
stories.summary: Hopes of a first-ever win over New Zealand were trampled along with Scotland's mission statement, writes Tom English.

stories.title: Baxters fish soup cans recalled over fears they could 'swell and rupture'
stories.summary: A manufacturing fault could cause a batch of the Cullen Skink soup to spoil, and cans could swell and burst.

stories.title: One of Scotland's last D-Day veterans dies, aged 100
stories.summary: Charlie Horne, from East Lothian, served on board a small minesweeper which cleared the way for the landing on Omaha Beach.

stories.title: Man killed in single-vehicle crash in Aberdeenshire
stories.summary: The 21-year-old was a passenger in a Toyota Yaris which crashed on the B9119, two miles east of Tarland.

stories.title: Franz Ferdinand turning to art at Glasgow Print Studio
stories.summary: Kirsty Wark and Sanjeev Kohli are also among those taking part in the Call and Response project.
